statement: SELECT concat_ws(' | ', cast(date(window.start) as string), drift_type, cast(round(avg_delta,3) as string), cast(round(js_distance,4) as string), cast(round(ks_test.statistic,3) as string)) AS row FROM workspace.mlpab768409.prediction_log_drift_metrics WHERE column_name='prediction' AND avg_delta IS NOT NULL ORDER BY abs(avg_delta) DESC LIMIT 10
